summary: E-Power Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting on September 4, 2026. The meeting will consider a share consolidation: every 25 Class A and Class B ordinary shares (par value $0.0001) will consolidate into one share with par value $0.0025, effective September 18, 2026. Authorized capital remains $500,000, with share counts adjusted accordingly. Fractional shares will be rounded up. A special resolution will adopt amended articles. This routine capital restructuring, not a special situation, has no strategic implications; watch shareholder approval and implementation of consolidation.
